task: Lightly copyedit this everyday support reply for a reader with a doctorate in robotics who is new to the building's room-booking system. The reader needs instructions, not an argument, thesis, research gap, or literature review. This is not an academic task. Return the reply unchanged if it already explains the supplied workflow clearly.
input: To reserve the shared room, open the booking page and choose an available slot. Add your meeting title, then select Save. You can change the booking from My reservations.

facts.text: The fictional building's shared room is reserved through its booking page.
The user chooses an available slot.
The user adds a meeting title.
My reservations allows the user to change the booking.
